look: a mephistkin woman, a devil-folk with crimson skin, a very long wild wavy mane of black hair parted down the middle, two dark red-brown ridged horns and a lean build
dome: cap of long wild wavy black hair parted down the middle
torso_tilt: first the top plane of a slim chest, then, tucked under the chest, a short glimpse of the flat upper belly.
torso_paint: the torso as one slim smooth chest with a flat upper belly below it
face_paint: the head as a cap of long wild wavy black hair with soft blue-grey sheen seen from above, parted down the middle, with, in the narrow strip along its bottom edge, a natural mephistkin face strongly foreshortened from above, the hair fringe shading the eyes, a nose tip, closed lips and the front of the chin
arms_paint: smooth shoulders and collarbones across the shoulder band; slender level arms with soft, lightly defined muscle

horns.guide: A dark ridged horn grows from each side of the front of the head, beside the face, and sweeps backward and outward over the hair to a fine tip.
horns.paint: the two horns as dark red-brown ridged horn

mane_a.label: hair
mane_a.guide: Behind the body the long hair hangs down the back and flares out to both sides, showing below each upper arm as a wing of loose locks.
mane_a.paint: the hair below the arms as loose wavy locks

notes: head-size rule: the legacy head frame (0.209 of the half span) is a circle on the hair mass; skull built at 0.150, hair cap x1.39
